result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed. One clear visual defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant title is truncated or its last letter is corrupted. Some minor styling concerns also exist. The partially visible carousel items and the cut-off pizza card are expected and not reported.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Ramei' (the final letter is clipped or rendered incorrectly, likely 'Ramen'). The title has plenty of horizontal room, so this is not a legitimate truncation. It looks like a text rendering or clipping bug.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text container so the full title 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders (check width, padding, and font line-height/overflow clipping). If it must truncate, use an ellipsis.

issues.description: The time pill badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the plate image and sit close to the card's bottom edge. On the first card the badge covers part of the bowl, making the imagery look cluttered.
issues.suggestion: Adjust badge placement or the image crop so the pill does not cover the main subject, and keep consistent padding from the card edges.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'min. order', inactive nav labels, search placeholder) is light gray on a light background and has low contrast. The white heart icon on the semi-transparent dark circle also varies in contrast depending on the image behind it.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast and give the favorite button a consistently opaque background.
